name: ldb-monitor
help: Configure server load balancing health monitors.

type.name: type
type.help: Select the Monitor type used by the health check monitor to check the health of the server (PING | TCP | HTTP | HTTPS | DNS).

interval.name: interval
interval.help: Time between health checks (5 - 65535 sec, default = 10).

timeout.name: timeout
timeout.help: Time to wait to receive response to a health check from a server. Reaching the timeout means the health check failed (1 - 255 sec, default = 2).

retry.name: retry
retry.help: Number health check attempts before the server is considered down (1 - 255, default = 3).

port.name: port
port.help: Service port used to perform the health check. If 0, health check monitor inherits port configured for the server (0 - 65535, default = 0).

http-get.name: http-get
http-get.help: URL used to send a GET request to check the health of an HTTP server.

http-match.name: http-match
http-match.help: String to match the value expected in response to an HTTP-GET request.

http-max-redirects.name: http-max-redirects
http-max-redirects.help: The maximum number of HTTP redirects to be allowed (0 - 5, default = 0).

dns-protocol.name: dns-protocol
dns-protocol.help: Select the protocol used by the DNS health check monitor to check the health of the server (UDP | TCP).

dns-request-domain.name: dns-request-domain
dns-request-domain.help: Fully qualified domain name to resolve for the DNS probe.

dns-match-ip.name: dns-match-ip
dns-match-ip.help: Response IP expected from DNS server.
